# CS 340 — Introduction to Databases

Institution: Wasatch State University
Instructor: Dr. Ada Lovelace
Meets: MWF 10:00-10:50
Term: Fall 2026
Start: 2026-08-24
End: 2026-12-11

## Learning Outcomes

Explain relational algebra and query planning.
Design normalized schemas from functional dependencies.
Write correct SQL queries against a normalized schema.
Diagnose and repair a slow query with an index.
